about: Each graded piece: one vendor design, three looks of it. base is worn below ★10, r10 from ★10, r20 from ★20.
A string is one of the design's own colours. An object recolours a colour where the design has no fitting one,
or where another piece already wears it, so no two looks in the catalog are the same picture:
tint keeps the part's light and dark and gives it that colour (sharp tint). Gold for ★10, and for ★20 the class's jewel:
emerald for Light, sapphire for Medium, ruby for Heavy, amethyst for Magic (another jewel where the part is already that colour).
hue turns the part's colours by that many degrees (sharp modulate); keepGold leaves its gold trim as it is.

base.look: red eye in a wooden crook
